title: Geometry-Preserving Human-to-Robot Upper-Body Motion Retargeting from Monocular Video
title_zh: 跨视图人体动作重定位与跨视图手部适应

paragraphs.en: Monocular RGB video provides an accessible source of human demonstrations for upper-body robot motion, yet video-driven human-to-robot transfer remains challenging because body and hand motion are recovered at different spatial scales, human and robot kinematics differ substantially, and fine distal motion is difficult to preserve across embodiments. We present a geometry-preserving motion-retargeting framework that integrates unified body–hand reconstruction with morphology-independent geometric transfer. Frame-wise body estimates, video-level observations, and detailed hand evidence jointly constrain a single differentiable Momentum Human Rig (MHR) state, while transient hand artifacts are repaired in parameter space. The reconstructed motion is represented by arm-segment directions, elbow configuration, relative palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations, and is realized on the target robot through multi-stage inverse kinematics and robot-specific hand adaptation. Within the broader system, Across-VAM provides video generation, whereas Across-WAM performs human-to-robot motion mapping. The method is evaluated on 16 monocular videos comprising 1,769 source frames, including 10 signing and six reach-to-grasp sequences. Unified reconstruction reduces mean hand reprojection error from 22.36 to 7.21 pixels relative to SAM 3D Body. All 16 retargeted trajectories completed kinematic simulation playback, and representative signing and reach-to-grasp motions were further demonstrated on a physical robot. The results demonstrate a unified pipeline from monocular human video to coordinated upper-body motion on a dual-arm dexterous robot.

paragraphs.en: Human motion provides a rich source of demonstrations for robots. Acquiring such demonstrations commonly relies on motion-capture systems, wearable devices, teleoperation interfaces, or task-specific instrumentation [ 1 , 2 ] . Monocular RGB video provides a widely accessible alternative for capturing natural human behavior. Recovering motion from such videos and transferring it to robots with different kinematics is therefore an important problem in robot programming and human–robot interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 人体动作为机器人提供了丰富的示范来源。 获取此类示范通常依赖于动作捕捉系统、可穿戴设备、遥操作接口或特定任务的专用设备 [1, 2]。 单目 RGB 视频为捕捉自然的人类行为提供了一种易于获取的替代方案。 因此，从此类视频中恢复动作并将其迁移到具有不同运动学的机器人上，是机器人编程与人机交互中的一个重要问题。

paragraphs.en: This capability is particularly relevant to assistive applications that involve both communicative and physical behaviors. Sign-language reproduction requires coordinated bilateral arm motion, palm orientation, and distinctive hand configurations, whereas reach-to-grasp behavior relies on coordinated motion of the arm, wrist, and hand toward an interaction target [ 3 , 4 ] . Prior work has studied latent optimization for sign retargeting [ 5 ] , video-driven sign transfer [ 6 ] , humanoid sign reproduction [ 3 ] , dedicated anthropomorphic signing hands [ 7 ] , and tactile fingerspelling systems [ 8 ] . Human demonstrations have also supported functional multifinger grasping [ 9 ] , reactive dexterous handover [ 10 ] , and long-horizon dual-arm manipulation [ 11 ] . Although signing and reaching stress different aspects of motion, both require task-relevant geometry to be preserved across different link lengths, joint arrangements, and hand actuation mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 这一能力对于同时涉及交流行为和物理行为的辅助应用尤为重要。 手语再现需要双臂的协调运动、手掌朝向以及独特的手部构型，而抓取行为则依赖于手臂、手腕和手向交互目标的协调运动 [ 3 , 4 ] 。 已有工作研究了用于手语重定向的隐空间优化 [ 5 ] 、基于视频的手语迁移 [ 6 ] 、人形机器人的手语再现 [ 3 ] 、专门的拟人手语手 [ 7 ] 以及触觉手指拼写系统 [ 8 ] 。 人类示范还支持了功能性多指抓取 [ 9 ] 、反应式灵巧交接 [ 10 ] 以及长时程双臂操作 [ 11 ] 。 尽管手语和抓取强调运动的不同方面，但两者都要求在与不同的连杆长度、关节布局和手部驱动机制之间保持与任务相关的几何特性。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge lies in obtaining a coherent human representation from monocular video. Global body motion and fine hand articulation appear at substantially different spatial scales and exhibit different estimation characteristics. HMR established direct regression of parametric human shape and pose from RGB images [ 12 ] , and HMR 2.0 extended transformer-based mesh recovery to video tracking [ 13 ] . Component-aware whole-body reconstruction allocates representation capacity across body regions [ 14 ] , while Hand4Whole emphasizes dedicated features for fine hand articulation [ 15 ] . Hand-specific models provide complementary distal detail. MANO offers a compact parametric hand model [ 16 ] , and HaMeR, Deformer, and Dyn-HaMR advance monocular hand reconstruction, temporal fusion, and interacting-hand recovery [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心挑战在于如何从单目视频中获取连贯一致的人体表征。 全局身体运动与精细的手部关节动作在空间尺度上差异显著，并且表现出不同的估计特性。 HMR 实现了从 RGB 图像直接回归参数化人体形状和姿态 [ 12 ]，HMR 2.0 将基于 transformer 的网格恢复扩展到了视频跟踪 [ 13 ]。 组件感知的全身重建将表征能力分配到不同身体区域 [ 14 ]，而 Hand4Whole 强调为精细的手部关节动作提供专用特征 [ 15 ]。 针对手部的专用模型能够提供互补的远端细节。 MANO 提供了一个紧凑的参数化手部模型 [ 16 ]，而 HaMeR、Deformer 和 Dyn-HaMR 则分别推进了单目手部重建、时序融合以及交互手部恢复 [ 17 , 18 , 19 ]。

paragraphs.en: Recent full-body representations provide a common state for combining these observations. SAM 3D Body reconstructs body and hands with the Momentum Human Rig (MHR) [ 20 , 21 ] , while SAM-Body4D incorporates video-level temporal information [ 22 ] . For video-to-robot transfer, detailed hand evidence should remain kinematically coupled with the wrist, forearm, elbow, and shoulder rather than being attached to the body after independent estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的全身表示为融合这些观测提供了统一的状态。 SAM 3D Body 使用动量人体骨架（Momentum Human Rig, MHR）[20, 21] 重建身体和手部，而 SAM-Body4D 则引入了视频级的时间信息 [22]。 对于从视频到机器人的迁移，手部的详细证据应与手腕、前臂、肘部和肩部保持运动学耦合，而不是在独立估计后再附加到身体上。

paragraphs.en: Cross-embodiment realization introduces a second challenge. The same human motion can correspond to substantially different robot joint configurations because of morphological differences. Consequently, the choice of preserved geometric attributes becomes central to retargeting. Optimization-based whole-body methods use task-space quantities and robot kinematics [ 23 ] . DexPilot and AnyTeleop extend this principle to coordinated arm–hand control [ 24 , 1 ] , while DexCap and LEGATO introduce embodiment-aware representations for demonstration transfer and acquisition [ 2 , 25 ] . General Motion Retargeting studies morphology-aware references for whole-body tracking [ 26 ] , and BeyondRetarget explores direct monocular-video-to-humanoid generation with shared visual features and robot-specific decoders [ 27 ] . Spatio-temporal retargeting further separates morphology-aware spatial adaptation from temporal refinement [ 28 ] . These results motivate an explicit geometric representation whose spatial realization and temporal conditioning can be evaluated separately.
paragraphs.zh: 跨本体实现带来了第二个挑战。 由于形态差异，同一个人体动作可能对应差异很大的机器人关节配置。 因此，保留哪些几何属性的选择成为重定向的核心问题。 基于优化的全身方法利用任务空间量和机器人运动学 [ 23 ] 。 DexPilot 和 AnyTeleop 将这一原理扩展到手臂—手部的协调控制 [ 24 , 1 ] ，而 DexCap 和 LEGATO 则为示教迁移与采集引入了感知本体的表示 [ 2 , 25 ] 。 General Motion Retargeting 研究了用于全身跟踪的感知形态的参考 [ 26 ] ，BeyondRetarget 则利用共享视觉特征和机器人专属解码器探索从单目视频直接生成人形机器人动作 [ 27 ] 。 时空重定向进一步将感知形态的空间适配与时间细化分离开来 [ 28 ] 。 这些结果促使我们采用一种显式的几何表示，使其空间实现和时间条件化可以被分别评估。

paragraphs.en: We address these challenges through a two-stage framework for geometry-preserving upper-body motion retargeting. First, body-level and hand-level observations jointly optimize a single differentiable Momentum Human Rig (MHR) state. This unified representation couples fine hand reconstruction with the complete supporting upper-body kinematic chain. Transient distal artifacts are subsequently corrected in MHR parameter space while preserving the articulated representation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个面向保几何上半身动作重定向的两阶段框架来应对这些挑战。 首先，身体层级与手部层级的观测共同优化单一可微分的 Momentum 人体装备（MHR）状态。 这一统一表示将精细的手部重建与完整的支撑上半身运动链耦合起来。 随后在 MHR 参数空间中修正瞬态的末端伪影，同时保留关节化表示。

paragraphs.en: Second, the reconstructed human motion is expressed through morphology-independent geometric attributes, including upper-arm and forearm directions, elbow configuration, palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations. Multi-stage numerical IK reconstructs these attributes through the target robot’s forward kinematics. Each frame is solved from a common initialization, followed by command-space temporal conditioning. Distal articulation is adapted through robot-specific handshape presets that match the coupled actuation space of the dexterous hands.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，重建的人体运动通过形态无关的几何属性来表达，包括上臂和前臂方向、肘部构型、手掌朝向以及双侧手腕关系。 多阶段数值逆运动学通过目标机器人的正向运动学来重建这些属性。 每一帧都从统一的初始化开始求解，随后进行指令空间的时间条件化。 远端关节通过特定于机器人的手型预设来适配，这些预设与灵巧手的耦合驱动空间相匹配。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the framework on 16 monocular videos comprising 10 signing and six reach-to-grasp sequences. Signing emphasizes bilateral coordination, palm orientation, and distinctive hand configurations, while reach-to-grasp emphasizes coordinated arm–wrist–hand motion during object-directed behavior. Together, the two categories evaluate geometric retargeting from monocular human video to a dual-arm robot.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 16 段单目视频上评估该框架，其中包括 10 段手语动作序列和 6 段伸手抓取序列。 手语动作强调双侧协调、手掌朝向以及独特的手部构型，而伸手抓取则强调面向物体行为中手臂—手腕—手的协调运动。 这两类任务共同评估了从单目人体视频到双臂机器人的几何重定向效果。

paragraphs.en: We formulate monocular upper-body reconstruction as a unified optimization over a single articulated MHR state, in which global body observations and detailed hand observations jointly constrain the connected body–hand kinematic chain. Model-space repair further improves the temporal consistency of distal articulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将单目上半身重建表述为对单个关节式 MHR 状态的统一优化，其中全局身体观测与精细手部观测共同约束相连的身体–手部运动学链。 模型空间修复进一步提升了远端关节的时序一致性。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a morphology-independent retargeting formulation that preserves arm-segment directions, elbow configuration, relative palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations. Multi-stage numerical IK reconstructs these attributes through the target robot’s own kinematics.

paragraphs.en: The proposed framework addresses upper-body motion retargeting from monocular human video to a dual-arm dexterous robot. It comprises human motion reconstruction, cross-embodiment geometric mapping, robot-joint adaptation, and task validation, as shown in Fig. 1 . The input is a monocular video acquired from a fixed viewpoint. SAM 3D Body, SAM-Body4D, and Dyn-HaMR respectively provide frame-wise human states, video-level body observations, and detailed hand observations. These signals jointly constrain the same differentiable MHR model. The optimization incorporates 2-D reprojection, local 3-D hand geometry, and temporal consistency to produce a coherent 3-D upper-limb–hand state for retargeting.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的框架解决了从单目人体视频到双臂灵巧机器人的上半身动作重定向问题。 如图 1 所示，它包括人体运动重建、跨本体几何映射、机器人关节适配以及任务验证。 输入是从固定视角采集的单目视频。 SAM 3D Body、SAM-Body4D 和 Dyn-HaMR 分别提供逐帧人体状态、视频级身体观测以及精细的手部观测。 这些信号共同约束同一个可微的 MHR 模型。 该优化融合了二维重投影、局部三维手部几何以及时间一致性，从而为重定向生成连贯的三维上肢—手部状态。

paragraphs.en: The unified human state is converted into cross-embodiment geometric attributes. They include upper-arm and forearm directions, elbow configuration, palm orientation, and, for bilateral actions, the relative relation between the two wrists. These quantities adapt more naturally to differences in scale and link length than absolute human joint positions. The target robot uses its own kinematic model to fit local arm geometry, palm orientation, and the combined geometric objectives in successive stages.
paragraphs.zh: 统一的人类状态被转换为跨具身几何属性。 这些属性包括上臂和前臂方向、肘部构型、手掌朝向，以及针对双手动作时两个手腕之间的相对关系。 相比绝对的人类关节位置，这些量能更自然地适应尺度和连杆长度的差异。 目标机器人使用自身的运动学模型，分阶段拟合局部手臂几何、手掌朝向以及组合的几何目标。

paragraphs.en: Robot-specific adaptation follows geometric mapping. Handshape information is extracted from the reconstructed 3-D hands and mapped to calibrated dexterous-hand commands. Arm and hand outputs obey robot joint limits, and bilateral poses are adjusted when necessary to maintain geometric clearance. Temporal conditioning then suppresses high-frequency changes introduced by frame-wise numerical optimization. The same framework handles signing and reach-to-grasp motion. The former emphasizes bilateral coordination, palm changes, and discrete handshapes, whereas the latter emphasizes unilateral approach, wrist adjustment, and grasp-state transitions. Generated motions are first validated kinematically in simulation and are then demonstrated on a physical robot.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人特定的适配遵循几何映射。 手型信息从重建的三维手部中提取，并映射到标定后的灵巧手指令。 手臂和手部输出遵循机器人关节限位，并在必要时调整双侧位姿以保持几何间隙。 随后通过时间条件化抑制逐帧数值优化引入的高频变化。 同一框架可同时处理手语和伸手抓取动作。 前者强调双侧协调、手掌变化和离散手型，而后者强调单侧接近、手腕调整和抓取状态转换。 生成的动作首先在仿真中进行运动学验证，随后在实体机器人上进行演示。

paragraphs.en: Optimization follows two stages. The first stage refines the bilateral arm parameters and camera translation so that wrist observations adjust the connected shoulder–elbow–wrist chain. The second stage releases the hand-pose variables and incorporates the complete 21-point 2-D and local 3-D hand observations. Because all terms share the same differentiable MHR state, distal evidence contributes directly to the connected wrist, forearm, elbow, upper arm, and clavicle configuration. The optimized sequence provides one coherent body–hand representation for subsequent retargeting.

paragraphs.en: Monocular hand reconstruction occasionally produces a short-lived departure from an otherwise coherent trajectory. We characterize this pattern through temporal round-trip consistency: a candidate frame exhibits a sufficiently large displacement from both neighboring states while the two neighboring states remain mutually consistent. paragraphs.en: The numerical solution proceeds through four stages. First, each active arm is fitted to its local direction and elbow targets. Second, bilateral sequences undergo joint refinement using cross-arm wrist relations. Third, palm orientation is fitted from the resulting arm configuration. Finally, all active joints are jointly refined using the complete geometric objective. Multiple initialization candidates are evaluated at each frame, and the valid solution with the lowest residual is retained. Each video frame uses the same robot reference initialization. This frame-independent formulation provides consistent numerical conditions throughout the sequence, after which temporal regularity is introduced at the command level.

paragraphs.en: Across the 16 sequences, the final unified MHR reconstruction achieved a mean hand reprojection error of 7.21 px, compared with 22.36 px for frame-wise SAM 3D Body and 23.84 px for SAM-Body4D (Table I ). The corresponding P95 error was 20.48 px, down from 68.84 px for SAM 3D Body. The mean reduction is approximately 67.8%. The final normalized local 3-D residual was 0.090, compared with 0.270 for SAM 3D Body and 0.284 for SAM-Body4D, an improvement of approximately 66.7% over SAM 3D Body. A 20,000-sample paired bootstrap using video sequences as the resampling unit estimated a 17.95 px reduction in sequence-level mean hand reprojection error relative to SAM 3D Body, with a 95% confidence interval of 12.61–23.25 px. The paired improvement in normalized local 3-D residual was 0.187 (95% confidence interval: 0.162–0.215). The late-fusion baseline directly attaches Dyn-HaMR local hand geometry to the reconstructed body; its local 3-D residual is therefore omitted from the comparison.

paragraphs.en: Before model-space repair, unified MHR yielded mean and P95 local 3-D residuals of 0.088 and 0.209. paragraphs.en: Across five bilateral signing sequences, independent-arm fitting preserved wrist-height ordering in 221 of 318 evaluable frames. Adding the bilateral relation increased agreement to 318/318 and reduced normalized wrist-separation error from 0.157 to 0.153 (Table II ). The paired sequence-level gain in height-order accuracy was 0.313 (95% confidence interval: 0.115–0.512).

sents.en: These results qualitatively validate the complete path from ordinary monocular video through unified body–hand reconstruction and cross-embodiment retargeting to physical execution.

paragraphs.en: This article presented a geometry-preserving framework for transferring upper-body and hand motion from monocular human video to a morphologically different dual-arm robot. Unified body–hand reconstruction jointly constrains frame-wise body estimates, video-level observations, and detailed hand observations in one differentiable MHR state. Model-space repair improves the temporal stability of distal motion. Relative arm geometry, calibrated palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations then define morphology-independent targets for multi-stage inverse kinematics. Robot-specific handshapes and temporal conditioning complete the dexterous-hand adaptation and command sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种保持几何结构的框架，用于将上半身和手部运动从单目人体视频迁移到形态不同的双臂机器人。 统一的躯体—手部重建在一个可微分 MHR 状态中联合约束逐帧躯体估计、视频级观测和精细手部观测。 模型空间修复提升了末端运动的时序稳定性。 相对手臂几何、标定后的手掌朝向以及双侧腕部关系随后定义了与形态无关的目标，用于多阶段逆运动学。 机器人特定的手型和时序调节完善了灵巧手适配与指令序列。

sents.en: This article presented a geometry-preserving framework for transferring upper-body and hand motion from monocular human video to a morphologically different dual-arm robot.
sents.zh: 本文提出了一种保持几何结构的框架，用于将上半身和手部运动从单目人体视频迁移到形态不同的双臂机器人。

sents.en: Unified body–hand reconstruction jointly constrains frame-wise body estimates, video-level observations, and detailed hand observations in one differentiable MHR state.

sents.en: Model-space repair improves the temporal stability of distal motion.
sents.zh: 模型空间修复提升了末端运动的时序稳定性。

sents.en: Relative arm geometry, calibrated palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations then define morphology-independent targets for multi-stage inverse kinematics.
sents.zh: 相对手臂几何、标定后的手掌朝向以及双侧腕部关系随后定义了与形态无关的目标，用于多阶段逆运动学。

sents.en: Robot-specific handshapes and temporal conditioning complete the dexterous-hand adaptation and command sequence.
sents.zh: 机器人特定的手型和时序调节完善了灵巧手适配与指令序列。

paragraphs.en: On 16 monocular sequences containing 1,769 source frames, unified MHR reconstruction reduced mean hand reprojection error from 22.36 to 7.21 px. Model-space repair reduced detected round-trip hand outliers from 138 to 12. Relative geometry reduced sequence-level mean forearm and palm errors by 5.57 ∘ and 3.48 ∘ compared with absolute-position transfer. Bilateral wrist constraints improved the preservation of relative wrist configuration. Gaussian conditioning reduced the maximum adjacent-frame joint increment from 17.09 ∘ to 10.49 ∘ while introducing only small geometric changes. All 16 trajectories completed Isaac kinematic playback with finite joint states and no model joint-limit violations.
paragraphs.zh: 在包含 1,769 个源帧的 16 个单目序列上，统一的 MHR 重建将手部平均重投影误差从 22.36 像素降低到 7.21 像素。 模型空间修复将检测到的手部往返离群值从 138 个减少到 12 个。 与绝对位置迁移相比，相对几何将序列级的平均前臂和手掌误差分别降低了 5.57∘ 和 3.48∘。 双侧手腕约束改善了对相对手腕姿态的保持。 高斯条件化将相邻帧的最大关节增量从 17.09∘ 降低到 10.49∘，同时仅引入很小的几何变化。 全部 16 条轨迹都完成了 Isaac 运动学回放，且关节状态有限、无模型关节极限违规。

paragraphs.en: Signing and reach-to-grasp evaluate complementary forms of upper-body motion. The former emphasizes bilateral coordination, palm orientation, and handshape, whereas the latter emphasizes coordinated arm approach, wrist orientation, and grasp configuration. Physical experiments with reach-to-grasp, person , and thank you show that the same command interface transfers motions from simulation to the Haier S01 robot. The resulting system forms a complete pipeline from ordinary monocular video to unified body–hand reconstruction, cross-embodiment geometric retargeting, and physical robot execution. Future work will address moving cameras, continuous dexterous-finger motion, explicit object and contact constraints, and additional robot morphologies.
paragraphs.zh: 手语表达与够取抓握评估上肢运动的互补形式。 前者强调双手协调、手掌朝向和手形，而后者强调手臂协同接近、手腕朝向和抓握构型。 针对 reach-to-grasp、person 和 thank you 的物理实验表明，同一命令接口可以将运动从仿真迁移到 Haier S01 机器人上。 由此形成的系统构成了一个从普通单目视频到统一的身体–手部重建、跨具身几何重定向以及物理机器人执行的完整流程。 未来工作将解决移动相机、连续灵巧手指运动、显式物体与接触约束以及更多机器人形态等问题。
